name: overprint-misregister
title: Overprint Misregister
description: Simulated CMYK misregistration: cyan, magenta and yellow copies of the word sit one pixel off each side of a black key plate, and dragging a control shifts the plates further out of register like a cheap print run.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Offset Dial: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
